prompt: Close-up of hot vegetable soup being ladled calmly into a rustic bowl, chunks of potato, carrot and dark leafy greens tumbling in, steam rising on contact. Two hands wrap around the bowl on a worn wooden table. Warm afternoon side light through curtains, 3800K. Unhurried confident motion, the hands settle around the bowl at the end. Audio: a warm Brazilian woman's voice says in Brazilian Portuguese: 'Quando a semana já está planejada, sobra tempo pra isso.' Soft ladling sounds underneath. 8 seconds, 1080p.
